fieldDescription: TRUE: Trophy hullmods unlock normally, remain usable, and apply their normal effects; replacement story-point bonuses are inactive. FALSE: Learned and fitted trophy hullmods remain in the save but become inert and are hidden from the refit picker; each completed faction program or qualifying unique showcase instead adds 5 percent to Hall of Triumph story-point generation. Isa's dialogue is unchanged.

TRUE: When Nexerelin and MagicLib are enabled, incomplete Hall achievements are shown and their progress is checked. FALSE: Incomplete Hall achievements are hidden and make no progress; completed achievements remain visible. This setting has no effect when either optional mod is absent.
